8fedeaf6: ;If DV is defined, go to M^DIE17. If DV contains 'V', go to ^DIE3. If DV doesn't contain 'S', go to P. If X matches a code in ^DD(DP,DIFLD,12.1), execute that code. Otherwise, look up X in DU and execute any 'S' code in DIC('S'). If a match is found and DIC('S') passes, write the corresponding value from DU unless DB(DQ) is defined.
d92ff92e: ;Loop through entries in DU separated by ';'. If X matches the code portion of an entry, execute any 'S' code in DIC('S'). If DIC('S') passes, quit the loop.
df325bae: ;If no match was found in the previous loop, write the remaining text from the last entry in DU that was processed (up to the next ';'). Set X to the code portion of that entry.
8adc089d: ;If DV contains 'P', set up DIC for a lookup in the file specified by the 'P' piece. If DV doesn't contain '*', perform the lookup and set X to the IEN of the entry selected.
bdb00b98: ;If DV doesn't contain 'N' and X is longer than 24 characters, kill X and go to Z.

68467d27: ;If the second piece of DV contains a comma, X contains a decimal point, and the fifth piece of DQ(DQ) doesn't start with '$', trim leading/trailing zeros from X. If the decimal portion has no non-zero digits, remove it.
